source.changes: Adapted the twelve stat blocks of issue #177 (Wight, Will-o’-Wisp, Winter Wolf, Wolf, Worg, Wraith, Wyvern, Xorn, Young Black Dragon, Young Blue Dragon, Young Brass Dragon and Young Bronze Dragon; PDF pages 264, 266, 268, 270, 341–343 and 364) into typed mechanical fields and implementation keys. Trait, action and bonus action entries keep their source rules text, rejoined across line, column and page breaks; descriptive prose outside the stat blocks is omitted. No playable NPC behavior is granted.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.text: Sunlight Sensitivity. While in sunlight, the wight has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Multiattack. The wight makes two attacks, using Necrotic Sword or Necrotic Bow in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Life Drain.

effects.text: The wight makes two attacks, using Necrotic Sword or Necrotic Bow in any combination

effects.text: using Necrotic Sword or Necrotic Bow

actions.name: Necrotic Sword
actions.text: Necrotic Sword. Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Necrotic Bow
actions.text: Necrotic Bow. Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.text: Life Drain. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, one creature within 5 feet. Failure: 6 (1d8 + 2) Necrotic damage, and the target’s Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken. A Humanoid slain by this attack rises 24 hours later as a Zombie under the wight’s control, unless the Humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. The wight can have no more than twelve zombies under its control at a time.

traits.text: Ephemeral. The wisp can’t wear or carry anything.

traits.text: Illumination. The wisp sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.text: Incorporeal Movement. The wisp can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

bonus_actions.name: Consume Life
bonus_actions.text: Consume Life. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, one living creature the wisp can see within 5 feet that has 0 Hit Points. Failure: The target dies, and the wisp regains 10 (3d6) Hit Points.

actions.name: Create Specter
actions.text: Create Specter. The wraith targets a Humanoid corpse within 10 feet of itself that has been dead for no longer than 1 minute. The target’s spirit rises as a Specter in the space of its corpse or in the nearest unoccupied space. The specter is under the wraith’s control. The wraith can have no more than seven specters under its control at a time.
